title: Slate -- the Chair's draft of the committee's agreed best (R34, R36 round 4)
x_purpose: At most 15 tickets across ADVANCE and WATCH (a ceiling, not a target; never padded). Each ticket carries its entry trigger, where it is wrong, horizon, why the room agrees and who dissents and why. The Chair uses ONLY what the seats said in their case forms and floor messages; it adds no view and never judges the quality of a reason. ADVANCE = the committee wants to act on the trigger. WATCH = it wants the name but is waiting on a condition (rendered WATCH; machine verdict HOLD-FOR-CONDITIONS so every downstream reader is unchanged).

chair.x_note: the Chair is not a voice (R36)

board_sha256.x_note: sha256 of board.json the slate was drafted from

ticker.x_note: must be in the deliberation set; unique

entry_trigger.x_note: for WATCH: the condition the room is waiting on

horizon_sessions.x_note: the horizon the agreeing seats stated (the Chair reports; it does not invent)

why_agreed.x_note: in the seats' words; attribute by name

sources.x_note: msg_ids and 'r2:<voice>' the ticket was built from

x_registrar_extra_checks: every ticker in phase4 deliberation_set; no duplicates
why_agreed / wrong_if using a bracket as a disqualifier => REJECT (R1)
